node.acceptance_condition: The proof derives the algebraic identity (pz - q)(pw - q) = q^2 from 1/z + 1/w = p/q using exact fractions, shows the factors are positive integers congruent to -q mod p, and proves the inverse map from admissible factor pairs to positive integer solutions (z,w) with z <= w. All steps are exact algebra with no hidden assumptions.
node.expected_contribution: A complete, citable proof of the bijection that the parent can include verbatim in the lemma.
node.objective: State and prove, in both directions with exact algebra, that for coprime positive integers p and q, the positive integer solutions (z,w) of 1/z + 1/w = p/q with z <= w correspond bijectively to factor pairs (u,v) of q^2 such that u <= v, u ≡ -q (mod p), v ≡ -q (mod p), via u = pz - q and v = pw - q.
node.rationale: The bijection proof is the foundational contribution of the lemma. It is independent of the counting formula details and the worked example, so it can be developed and verified in parallel.
